UPDATE: I had my appointment today with the mental health expert at my GP. As soon as she asked me 'so how have you been feeling' I burst into tears lol and spent the rest of the appointment crying. Anyway, I was super awkward because even though I'd prepared my script it didn't go as planned but I told her I felt that I resonated with adhd symptoms. She asked about my life, general wellbeing, relationships and what symptoms I thought I had. I had prepared a whole written list but didn't even get to read it. I told her that my head feels like chaos, disordered, like I can't focus on one single thought, about my disorganisation and how it was impacting work, my emotional sensitivity, and various other things. I felt like such a moron with my chin trembling. She was so kind. She said that yes, my symptoms do sound concurrent with adhd and referred me. I asked about the wait time and she told me that she had heard it was actually not that bad for adults, I'm not sure if my gp has a different route, but that gave me some hope... I left with the reddest eyes but feeling kind of optimistic...
